It has promised to pay those charges itself when an AI provider will not refund them. The company builds and runs apps for its customers and stores their secrets, such as API keys and database
stories.rookie: Private data got out. Stolen data is later reused for scams and account takeover.
actions: Check if client staff email domains appear in the leak (Have I Been Pwned domain search).
Note the UK GDPR angle: serious breaches must be reported to the ICO within 72 hours.
enrich_steps: Sector (Transport / Logistics) → tag every client in that sector and send them a short heads-up

stories.title: Microsoft Researchers Show AI Agents Can Be Backdoored by Editing Fewer Than 10 Neurons
stories.summary: An AI model can be given a hidden backdoor by editing fewer than 10 of its rarely used neurons, without retraining the model, Microsoft researchers have shown. When a chosen trigger appears, the model outputs an attacker's command, which an agent using that model would run with the agent's own permissions. The attacker must be able to change the model's weights. The team tested the method on
stories.rookie: Malicious software, for example info-stealers that grab saved passwords and cookies.
actions: Extract hashes, domains and IPs and push them to client blocklists or the SIEM.
Check the malware family on MalwareBazaar or ThreatFox for more indicators.
